newsitem.title: UK: UK shares lifted by Dow rally, volumes seen thin.
newsitem.headline: UK shares lifted by Dow rally, volumes seen thin.

text.p: ** FTSE 100 opens stronger, pushed up by Dow's strong
overnight gains. Traders expect persistant low volumes
to cap market rise. Output data due at 0830 GMT.
** Smiths advances after in-line results, bullish comment.
** St James surges after Prudential bid for bigger stake.
The rise is seen at a year-on-year 1.6 percent, or 0.3 percent for the month.

"The market will look at these figures but only for their historical value," said one strategist. "Obviously as far as industrial companies are concerned, we've had a strong leg up on sterling so there are far greater, more recent concerns," he said.
Continuing thin trading volumes are expected to keep levels down, dealers and strategists said.
By 0809 GMT volume was a meagre 41 million shares.
Most heavily traded was St James Place.
The shares rose 6-1/2p to 132p with seven million changing hands after news that Prudential plans to acquire a controlling stake in the company. Prudential shares rose 4p to 562p.
Smiths Industries was another big gainer, risihg 10-1/2p to 806p after releasing first half results.

Smiths made a bullish statement with its results which were in line with market forecasts. The company said that it had benefited from an upturn in the world aerospace industry and had been less affected than some other companies by the stronger currency.
"The results were solid," said Andy Chambers, industry analyst at SocGen. "A fairly confident statement and good progress in the aerospace division, which is encouraging."
